learning_outcomes.text: Know and apply the applicable regulations (CTE and RITE).
Know what thermal comfort and indoor air quality depend on and how they are measured.
Calculate and analyze the thermal load of a residential building.
Use psychrometry for the design of all-air systems.
Analyze the operation of cooling and heat pump equipment.
Design the contribution of renewable energies to a residential building.
Understand the fundamentals of different air conditioning systems.
Perform the energy certification of a building.

syllabus_topics: THERMAL COMFORT AND INDOOR AIR QUALITY
assessment_rules: The course will be passed by completing and presenting the energy certification works for the proposed residential building and for the UMH building's air conditioning systems. The works will be graded using rubrics.
